commit.subject: LU-20264 llite: report idmapped owners in getattr
commit.message:
LU-20264 llite: report idmapped owners in getattr

Pass the VFS-provided mnt_idmap into ll_getattr_dentry() and report
the inode owner through i_uid_into_vfsuid()/i_gid_into_vfsgid() so
stat() on an idmapped mount sees the mapped uid/gid.

Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Timothy Day <timday@thelustrecollective.com>
Change-Id: Id46282dcb629b33244ba4dfe678c71266a6a6964
